statements.text: This bill will simply mandate that the SBA report to Congress annually about the use of AI and machine learning by the SBA.
statements.context: Speaking at a House Small Business Committee markup in support of his bill, the SBA Artificial Intelligence Utilization Act.

statements.text: This legislation requires the Small Business Administration to report its use of AI and machine learning within their operations, while also assessing the advantages and risks.
statements.context: Floor speech in the U.S. House of Representatives advocating for H.R. 8881, the SBA Artificial Intelligence Utilization Act.
